investigations.name: biogears-sbml-sepsis
investigations.title: BioGears sepsis core: engine vs SBML extraction
investigations.description: A side-by-side comparison of the BioGears sepsis core run two ways — the real BioGears 8.2.0 engine (viva-biogears) versus its SBML/Antimony extraction (viva-tellurium) — across a healthy baseline and mild and severe infection, plus two runtime axes: one comparing the Python process-bigraph engine with the Rust viva-core engine on the same composite (the composition engine), and one asking whether a faster or compiled ODE integrator could speed up the SBML model (the numerical solver).
investigations.question:
Does the Antimony/SBML extraction of the BioGears sepsis core reproduce the
real BioGears engine run-for-run — not merely against the McDaniel et al. 2019
paper milestones — and where does it diverge, and why?
investigations.hypothesis:
The extraction reproduces BioGears' healthy baseline and the qualitative mild
and severe infection outcomes, but the severe course lags the engine by several
hours and the two diverge on observables fed by processes the extraction does
not translate (urine, fever-driven vasodilation, lactate, intracellular water).
